body:
_Verify that the application limits the number of active concurrent sessions._

Why? Limiting sessions is not a security control, it's a hindrance.

This control is redundant, considering control: 3.17

comments.body: Normally I'd disagree with you but with the addition and rewording of 3.17, I now agree. Will remove this.

title: 3.16 - opinionated and redundant control
